Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Class Selection

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.Selection
public class Selection extends Object
A document-space selection: an axis-aligned bounding Rectangle plus an optional per-pixel mask. A rectangular marquee leaves the mask null (every pixel inside the bounds is selected); a lasso rasterises its polygon into a mask so only the enclosed pixels are selected.

The mask is stored row-major, w*h booleans, relative to the bounds origin. Selection itself holds no pixels; extract(java.awt.image.BufferedImage) pulls the selected region out of a layer (transparent elsewhere) for cut/copy/paste, and fill(java.awt.image.BufferedImage, java.awt.Color) paints a colour into the selected region in place. Moving and cropping are handled by translating the bounds / calling PaintDocument.crop(java.awt.Rectangle).
